interface.shortDescription: Selling or buying company data for AI training, answered
interface.longDescription: AI Training Data Broker is an independent broker for company data deals with AI labs. Its blog answers the questions both sides ask: for companies, what their support tickets, team chat and CRM history are worth to an AI lab, whether licensing it is legal, and how exclusivity and de-identification work; for labs and model teams, where to source licensed company workflow data and what RL data means. Ask a question, search by topic or see the latest articles: each answer is a summary or the opening of the article with a link to read the rest on aitrainingdatabroker.com. Read-only; articles are the broker's guidance, not legal advice.
capabilities: Latest articles for sellers or buyers
